title: GERMANY NEEDED FIVE GOALS. KLOPP'S SIDE SCORED FIVE.
description:
Five goals needed, five goals scored, and Klopp has already put a date on the doubters going quiet.

Germany had to beat the Netherlands by five goals. So they did. 5-0 in Berlin, and Germany top their Nations League group.

Florian Wirtz scored twice: a long-range strike in the 60th minute, then a volley in the 71st. Germany scored three in eleven minutes, which suggests the Dutch defence had somewhere else to be.

Jurgen Klopp took over in August, after Nagelsmann was dismissed following the World Cup exit to Paraguay. Klopp says this result will quiet the doubters for three or four months. It was also Germany's last game in an Adidas kit.

Three or four months of peace for Klopp: generous or optimistic? Tell us below.
